_comment: This is the content source for your portfolio. Edit the 'projects' array to update the projects section of your website. After editing, run 'npm run update-content' to apply the changes. Do not edit 'public/data.json' directly.

projects._comment: Each object in this array represents a project. Copy and paste this structure to add new projects.
projects.title: The RPG Portfolio Overhaul
projects.description: Transform a standard portfolio into an immersive RPG experience. This epic quest involves migrating to modern tooling (Vite, React 18, Tailwind CSS v4) and designing a unique character sheet interface that showcases skills as inventory items and projects as completed quests.
